'''Tover Blackmoor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chemist/Legends|chemist]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|It seems to have pretty impressive healing qualities, but I haven't isolated its exact function. What I do know is that it appears that the Black Sun want a piece of the action.|Tover Blackmoor, about the spice|<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" />}}
[[File:BlackSunBase.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The [[Black Sun bunker]].]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Tover Blackmoor worked for the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], one of the most powerful criminal syndicate in the galaxy, and operated out of a [[Black Sun bunker]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] moon of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. During that time, the Black Sun discovered that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] was smuggling and hoarding a new kind of [[Syren spice|spice]].<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Black Sun acquired a sample of this new spice after the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Cal Handro]] crash-landed on Rori while transporting it. Tover Blackmoor analyzed the spice and discovered that it was nothing like any other spice available on the marker. The Black Sun leaders therefore decided to obtain more spice but they attracted the attention of a group of spacers who were looking for Cal Handro, the missing pilot. The spacers attacked the Black Sun bunker and eventually forced Blackmoor to reveal everything he knew about the pilot and the new spice.<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateScientistHumanMale.png|thumb|right|250px|Every randomly-generated depiction of Edvar Vang.]]
Tover Blackmoor was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Tover Blackmoor was added to the game with the second chapter of the "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]" quest line, released with the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes: March 24, 2005|Publish 14.1]]," on [[March 24]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes: Publish 14.1 - March 24, 2005">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=734|text=Update Notes: Publish 14.1 - March 24, 2005}}</ref> All the content of the "Secrets of the Syren" story arc was removed from the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]], due to the major changes planed for Rori with the introduction of the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>

In the game, Tover Blackmoor was spelled '''Tovar Blackmoor''' in the quest objectives. During each server reset, Tover Blackmoor's appearance was randomized, but he consistently appeared as a male Human under the template "scientist_human_male".<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" />
